column1: # DSP block settings per multiplier mode (README (z11)), as Quartus wrote them in
# designs/p10/dq2 (specimens/runs/dq20): output register only, operands straight
# from the fabric, one clock, no enable or clear. a5pnr writes a mode's rows as they
# are; a5pnr readback recognises a block whose settings are exactly one mode's.
# The dsp_proginv_l/_h masks here are each mode's baseline: Quartus' own with the
# bit of the one pin it inverts cleared (the LFSR's bit 0, an inverted flop: pin 353
# in mul18u and mul27u, 335 in mul18s, 398 in mul27s). A block's mask differing from
# the baseline in a bit inverts that bit's pin (dsp.rs, proginv_pin).
